verdicts.label: SCAM
verdicts.what_is_true_en: The Indian government has not announced any "Prime Minister Free Laptop Scheme". Messages promoting such a scheme are fake and part of a scam. While some state governments have their own laptop schemes, there is no such national scheme.
verdicts.reasoning_en: The Indian government's Press Information Bureau (PIB) has explicitly stated that the "Prime Minister Free Laptop Scheme 2026" is fake and a scam. Multiple independent fact-checking organizations have debunked similar claims repeatedly over several years, confirming that no such central government scheme exists. These claims are part of recurring scams.

verdicts.label: SCAM
verdicts.what_is_true_en: There is no deadline for the "Prime Minister Free Laptop Scheme" because the scheme itself does not exist. This claim is part of a fraudulent message.
verdicts.reasoning_en: Since the "Prime Minister Free Laptop Scheme 2026" has been confirmed to be fake by government sources, any associated deadline, including October 15, is also false. The claim is part of a larger scam.

verdicts.label: SCAM
verdicts.what_is_true_en: The website www.pm-free-laptop-yojana.in is not an official government website and is associated with a fake scheme. The government's Press Information Bureau has warned that such links are part of a scam.
verdicts.reasoning_en: The Indian government's Press Information Bureau (PIB) has debunked the "Prime Minister Free Laptop Scheme" and warned that associated registration links are part of a scam. Multiple fact-checking organizations have identified similar links as fraudulent or phishing attempts designed to steal personal information. Official Indian government websites end in ".gov.in".
